# no-missing-space-closed-atx

- ID: `MD020`
- Category: Headings
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `headings`, `atx_closed`, `spaces`

A closed heading at the start of a line has a space inside each run of \#.

## Why

Without the spaces, the closing \# marks show as heading text, or the line is
not a heading at all.

## Options

This rule has no options.

## Fix

The fix inserts the missing spaces. gomdlint reports the line without a fix when
the document may link to heading anchors, because the fix may add or change an
anchor. gomdlint may report a finding without a fix when the fix would change a
line with one character in brackets, such as \[x\] or \[1\], or the lines around
it up to a blank line, because it could add or remove a task list checkbox.

## Example

This document breaks the rule:

```markdown
# Guide #

##Install ##

Run the installer.
```

gomdlint reports:

```text
3:1 No space after opening hashes on closed ATX style heading
```

The fix changes it to:

```markdown
# Guide #

## Install ##

Run the installer.
```

## Configure

Under `rules`, `no-missing-space-closed-atx: false` turns the rule off and
`no-missing-space-closed-atx: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable no-missing-space-closed-atx` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line no-missing-space-closed-atx -->
```
